title: An incident, and what runs alongside it
description: Four steps read across the page, with two continuous activities beside them: keeping the reporter informed, which runs above, and recording what was done, which runs below. Neither contains the steps and neither contains the other — they are peers, and a band is how that is said. A group could not: a box sits inside one container or none, so two groups over the same four boxes would have to nest, which draws a hierarchy that is not there.
caption: A band accompanies its members; a group contains them. The bar spans what it names and the words sit outside it, so a long name never reaches back over the boxes.
